nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex package, describing installation, uninstall, verify commands, full lifecycle capture fidelity (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PreCompact), and the fail-open hook architecture that wires OpenAI Codex events into hive-mind frames.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-codex v0.1.0, an OpenAI Codex silent-capture shim that routes conversation episodes into hive-mind frames; defines the codex-hooks CLI binary, four hook entrypoint exports, build/test scripts, and dependencies on hive-mind-hooks-core and hive-mind-shim-core.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ESM (type=module) with TypeScript project references to @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-core and @waggle/hive-mind-shim-core, following the monorepo's composite build pattern.
